# Data, Teleoperation & Training Infrastructure

> Datasets, data-collection and teleoperation systems, and training frameworks.  
> Layer: L6 · 89 entries · [overview](../README.md#data) · [survey](../SURVEY.md)

**Legend:** 🟢 open · 🟡 partial · 🔵 api · ⚪ closed. Hover a name for the full paper title. Newest first within each year.

**2026**

- ⚪ [**SPOT**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07933 "SPOT: Spatial Perception-Oriented Long-Horizon Humanoid Teleoperation") · 2026-09 · UMass Amherst / MIT — VR humanoid teleoperation that renders a stabilized robot-mounted fisheye stereo view on a virtual hemisphere, letting operators look around without moving the robot, for long-horizon loco-manipulation data collection.
- ⚪ [**Robot Data Factory**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16705 "The Robot Data Factory") · 2026-09 · MBZUAI — Proposes mission-driven robot training grounds that continuously generate, validate, benchmark and reuse robot experience in a Deploy-Measure-Learn-Repeat loop, with an agentic robot network and living benchmarks. [project](https://agentic-robotics-lab.github.io/robot-data-factory/)
- ⚪ [**RoboDrop**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.10021 "RoboDrop: Curating VLA Post-Training Data via Local Gradient Compatibility") · 2026-09 — Curation method that scores each VLA post-training sample by gradient compatibility with matched validation samples during a one-epoch warm-up, to filter execution mistakes, sensor drift and misaligned timestamps.
- ⚪ [**DexAgent**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35318 "DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library") · 2026-09 · Stanford University; Columbia University — Agentic pipeline that turns one egocentric human video and a prompt into physically grounded robot training trajectories, choosing or writing tools at each stage with property-specific verifiers, and keeping new skills in a self-evolving tool library. [project](https://dexagent123.github.io/)
- ⚪ [**ARSTAG**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24563 "ARSTAG: An Agentic Real2Sim2Real System for Task-Specific Robot Data Generation") · 2026-09 — Hierarchy of language agents turns one RGB image and an instruction into a sim scene, feasible demos and task-consistent randomization, with a coordinator for cross-stage recovery; pi0.5 reached 74.6% real success (first-party). [project](https://boweili666.github.io/ARSTAG/)
- ⚪ [**WorldSample**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02431 "WorldSample: Closed-loop Real-robot RL with World Modelling") · 2026-07 — Augments real-robot RL with transitions from a world model post-trained on real rollouts, using Policy-Paced Learning to select and schedule synthetic samples and limit hallucination-induced errors.
- 🟢 [**MEVION**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.17970 "MEVION: Low-Cost Open-Source Data Collection System for Powerful and High-Speed Dual-Arm Manipulation") · 2026-07 · University of Tokyo — ALOHA-style open-source dual-arm data-collection system built from e-commerce parts and welded sheet metal, with four 6-DoF arms (60 Nm peak torque) for heavier and faster tasks, at about USD 14,000 (first-party). [code](https://github.com/haraduka/mevion) · [project](https://haraduka.github.io/mevion-hardware/)
- ⚪ [**UniIntervene**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.12372 "UniIntervene: Agentic Intervention for Efficient Real-World Reinforcement Learning") · 2026-06 — Takes over most human interventions in human-in-the-loop RL with a model that estimates action value, detects stagnating progress via a value-risk critic, and steers the policy back toward high-value states. [project](https://denghaoyuan123.github.io/UniIntervene-project/)
- ⚪ [**RoboTacDex**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.31836 "RoboTacDex: A Dexterous Visual-Tactile-Action Dataset for Humanoid Manipulation") · 2026-06 — 6k Unitree G1 dexterous bimanual trajectories over 19 tasks with multi-view RGB-D, tactile feedback and semantic annotations, recorded with millisecond-synchronized multi-camera capture. _Note: Data release status not verified._
- ⚪ [**HATS**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16491 "HATS: A Human-Agent Teleoperation System for Multi-Arm Data Collection") · 2026-06 — One operator teleoperates two primary arms while a training-free MLLM agent runs two assistive arms, with voice commands for correction; collection efficiency comparable to two-person teams (first-party).
- ⚪ [**HARBOR**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08610 "HARBOR: A Harness Framework for Agentic Robot Reinforcement Learning") · 2026-06 · TU Darmstadt et al. — Treats robot RL automation as harness engineering: specialized agents take a simulator codebase from environment setup to trained policy through standardized commands, persistent artifacts, executable gates and parallel trials, across 16 tasks.
- ⚪ [**EgoEngine**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.12604 "EgoEngine: From Egocentric Human Videos to High-Fidelity Dexterous Robot Demonstrations") · 2026-06 · Georgia Tech et al. — Converts an egocentric RGB video into a robot-rendered observation video plus a feasibility-constrained robot action trajectory; reports zero-shot dexterous visuomotor policies without real-robot demos (first-party). [project](https://egoengine.github.io)
- ⚪ [**Learning While Deploying (LWD)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00416 "Learning While Deploying: Fleet-Scale Reinforcement Learning for Generalist Robot Policies") · 2026-05 — Offline-to-online RL that post-trains a flow-based VLA from autonomous rollouts and human interventions pooled across a 16-robot fleet; reports 95% average success on eight real tasks (first-party). [project](https://learning-while-deploying.github.io/)
- ⚪ [**HumanNet**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06747 "HumanNet: Scaling Human-centric Video Learning to One Million Hours") · 2026-05 · Peking University — One-million-hour corpus of first- and third-person human activity video with captions, motion descriptions and hand/body signals, curated as a pretraining source for embodied learning. _Note: As of 2026-09 the repo lists the corpus and curation pipeline release as pending._ [code](https://github.com/DAGroup-PKU/HumanNet) · [project](https://dagroup-pku.github.io/HumanNet/)
- ⚪ [**D-VLA**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13276 "D-VLA: A High-Concurrency Distributed Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models") · 2026-05 — Distributed RL framework for large VLAs that separates simulation data flow from weight control and overlaps sampling, inference, gradient computation and parameter sync in an asynchronous four-thread pipeline. _Note: Code release status not verified._
- 🟢 [**Open-H-Embodiment**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.21017 "Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics") · 2026-04 · Open-H-Embodiment Consortium (50+ institutions) — Open medical-robotics dataset of video with synchronized kinematics across platforms such as da Vinci, dVRK and CMR Versius (surgery, ultrasound, endoscopy); used to train the GR00T-H VLA and a Cosmos-H surgical world model. _Note: v1 data on Hugging Face (CC BY 4.0); the GitHub repo now hosts the v2 contribution guide. Model-weight release not checked._ [code](https://github.com/open-h/open-h-embodiment) · [project](https://open-h.github.io/open-h-embodiment/) · [data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PhysicalAI-Robotics-Open-H-Embodiment)
- 🟢 [**EgoVerse**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07607 "EgoVerse: An Egocentric Human Dataset for Robot Learning from Around the World") · 2026-04 · Georgia Tech, Stanford, UCSD, ETH Zurich, MIT, Meta + industry partners — Shared platform and dataset of 1,362 h (80k episodes) of egocentric human demos over 1,965 tasks, with academic and industry splits, standardized processing and human-robot co-training studies. [code](https://github.com/GaTech-RL2/EgoVerse)
- 🟢 [**EgoLive**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23570 "EgoLive: A Large-Scale Egocentric Dataset from Real-World Human Tasks") · 2026-04 — 1,680 h of 60 fps stereo egocentric video (65,866 episodes, 346 tasks) from home-service, retail and other real workplaces, captured with a custom head-mounted rig and annotated with hand poses, depth and sub-task captions. _Note: Paper calls it open-source with distribution via JD Cloud's robot-data market (link did not load for automated checks); corresponding author uses a jd.com address._
- 🟡 [**AGIBOT WORLD 2026**](https://www.agibot.com/article/231/detail/54.html) · 2026-04 · AgiBot — Real-world dataset collected by free-form teleoperation on the AgiBot G2 in homes and commercial spaces, with force/tactile streams, annotated error-recovery trajectories and 1:1 digital-twin sim data. _Note: Released in phases (phase 1 targets imitation learning); CC BY-NC-SA 4.0._ [data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/agibot-world/AgiBotWorld2026)
- ⚪ [**F-ACIL**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.25583 "Towards Generalizable Robotic Data Flywheel: High-Dimensional Factorization and Composition") · 2026-03 — Factor-aware data collection and iterative training that decomposes task diversity into object, action and environment factors; reports 45%+ gains with 5-10x fewer demonstrations (first-party).
- 🟢 [**RoboInter**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09973 "RoboInter: A Holistic Intermediate Representation Suite Towards Robotic Manipulation") · 2026-02 — Suite for plan-then-execute manipulation: an annotation GUI, a 230k-episode dataset with dense per-frame labels for 10+ intermediate representations, embodied VQA benchmarks and a plan-then-execute VLA framework. _Note: ICLR 2026._ [code](https://github.com/InternRobotics/RoboInter) · [project](https://lihaohn.github.io/RoboInter.github.io/) · [data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/InternRobotics/RoboInter-Data)
- ⚪ [**EgoScale**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16710 "EgoScale: Scaling Dexterous Manipulation with Diverse Egocentric Human Data") · 2026-02 · NVIDIA — Trains a VLA on 20,854 hours of action-labeled egocentric human video and finds a log-linear scaling law between human-data scale and validation loss that predicts real-robot performance; a two-stage recipe transfers to a 22-DoF dexterous hand. _Note: Used for GR00T N1.7 pretraining; code listed as coming soon._ [project](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/egoscale/)

**2025**

- 🟢 [**RoboMIND 2.0**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.24653 "RoboMIND 2.0: A Multimodal, Bimanual Mobile Manipulation Dataset for Generalizable Embodied Intelligence") · 2025-12 · X-Humanoid / Peking University — 310K+ dual-arm trajectories over six embodiments and 739 tasks, incl. 12K tactile and 20K mobile-manipulation episodes plus a 20K-trajectory digital-twin set; paired with the MIND-2 VLM-planner/VLA-executor system. RSS 2026. [code](https://github.com/RLinf/RLinf) · [docs](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/resources/publications/rlinf_vla.html)
- 🟢 [**piRL**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.25889 "πRL: Online RL Fine-tuning for Flow-based Vision-Language-Action Models") · 2025-10 · RLinf team (Tsinghua, PKU, CASIA, CMU, Infinigence AI, Zhongguancun Academy) — Online RL for flow-matching VLAs (pi0, pi0.5): Flow-Noise adds a learnable noise network for exact log-likelihoods and Flow-SDE turns denoising into an SDE for exploration; implemented in RLinf. - 🟢 [**Dexbotic**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.23511 "Dexbotic: Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Toolbox") · 2025-10 · Dexmal — PyTorch VLA toolbox that reproduces several mainstream policies (e.g. pi0, CogACT, OFT) in one environment via experiment scripts, with pretrained checkpoints and a unified data format and deployment for UR5, Franka and ALOHA. - 🟢 [**RLinf**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.15965 "RLinf: Flexible and Efficient Large-scale Reinforcement Learning via Macro-to-Micro Flow Transformation") · 2025-09 · RLinf team — Open-source RL infrastructure for embodied and agentic models that decomposes RL workflows and reschedules them for hardware efficiency; supports RL/SFT of VLAs such as pi0/pi0.5 in simulators and on real robots. _Note: Companion papers RLinf-VLA (arXiv 2510.06710) and piRL (arXiv 2510.25889) cover VLA-specific RL._ [code](https://github.com/RLinf/RLinf) · [docs](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)
- 🟢 [**Galaxea Open-World Dataset**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.00576 "Galaxea Open-World Dataset and G0 Dual-System VLA Model") · 2025-08 · Galaxea AI — Large mobile-manipulation dataset recorded in real homes and workplaces on one consistent embodiment with subtask-level language labels, released with G0, a VLM-planner plus VLA-executor dual-system model. - 🟢 [**RoboMIND**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.13877 "RoboMIND: Benchmark on Multi-embodiment Intelligence Normative Data for Robot Manipulation") · 2024-12 · X-Humanoid / Peking University — 107k teleoperated trajectories over 479 tasks on Franka, UR5e, AgileX dual-arm and a dexterous humanoid, including 5k failure demonstrations annotated with causes and an Isaac Sim digital twin. [project](https://x-humanoid-robomind.github.io/) · [data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/x-humanoid-robomind/RoboMIND)
- 🟢 [**AgiBot World**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.06669 "AgiBot World Colosseo: A Large-scale Manipulation Platform for Scalable and Intelligent Embodied Systems") · 2024-12 · AgiBot / Shanghai AI Lab (OpenDriveLab) — 1M+ real-robot trajectories over 217 tasks in five deployment scenarios, collected with a standardized pipeline and human-in-the-loop verification; released as AgiBot World Alpha/Beta with the GO-1 policy. _Note: Alpha data released Dec 2024, technical report Mar 2025, GO-1 weights Sep 2025._ [code](https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/AgiBot-World) · [project](https://agibot-world.com/) · [data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/agibot-world/AgiBotWorld-Beta)
- ⚪ [**SkillMimicGen (SkillGen)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.18907 "SkillMimicGen: Automated Demonstration Generation for Efficient Skill Learning and Deployment") · 2024-10 — Segments a few human demos into skills, adapts them to new scenes and stitches them with planned free-space motions to generate datasets, plus a Hybrid Skill Policy that sequences learned skills with motion planning. _Note: Code release status not verified._
- 🟢 [**HIL-SERL**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.21845 "Precise and Dexterous Robotic Manipulation via Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning") · 2024-10 · UC Berkeley — Real-world vision-based RL system built on the SERL suite that combines demos, human corrections and sample-efficient RL, reaching near-perfect success on dexterous tasks in 1-2.5 h of training (first-party). [code](https://github.com/rail-berkeley/hil-serl) · [project](https://hil-serl.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**EgoMimic**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.24221 "EgoMimic: Scaling Imitation Learning via Egocentric Video") · 2024-10 · Georgia Tech — Full-stack pipeline that records egocentric human demos with Project Aria glasses and 3D hand tracking, aligns them to a low-cost bimanual robot, and co-trains one policy on human and robot data. [code](https://github.com/SimarKareer/EgoMimic) · [project](https://egomimic.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**DexMimicGen**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.24185 "DexMimicGen: Automated Data Generation for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation via Imitation Learning") · 2024-10 · NVIDIA / UT Austin / UCSD — Extends MimicGen-style synthesis to bimanual humanoids with dexterous hands (21K sim demos from 60 human demos) and shows a real-to-sim-to-real pipeline on a humanoid can-sorting task. [code](https://github.com/NVlabs/dexmimicgen) · [project](https://dexmimicgen.github.io/)
- 🟡 [**FastUMI**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.19499 "FastUMI: A Scalable and Hardware-Independent Universal Manipulation Interface with Dataset") · 2024-09 · Shanghai AI Lab et al. — UMI redesign with decoupled hardware and an off-the-shelf tracking module instead of VIO for easier deployment across arms, released with 10,000+ real-world demonstrations over 22 everyday tasks. _Note: Project site (fastumi.com) was unreachable during verification; release details not re-checked._
- 🟢 [**ARIO**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.10899 "All Robots in One: A New Standard and Unified Dataset for Versatile, General-Purpose Embodied Agents") · 2024-08 · Peng Cheng Laboratory / SUSTech / Sun Yat-sen University et al. — Unified embodied data standard (format, sensor modalities, real plus simulated data) and a converted dataset of about 3M episodes from 258 series and 321,064 tasks. [project](https://imaei.github.io/project_pages/ario/) · [data](https://openi.pcl.ac.cn/ARIO/ARIO_Dataset)
- 🟢 [**Open-TeleVision**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.01512 "Open-TeleVision: Teleoperation with Immersive Active Visual Feedback") · 2024-07 · UC San Diego / MIT — Open-source VR teleoperation that streams stereo video from an actively moving robot head and mirrors the operator's arm and hand motion; used to collect long-horizon humanoid demonstrations. [code](https://github.com/OpenTeleVision/TeleVision) · [project](https://robot-tv.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**Manipulate-Anything**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.18915 "Manipulate-Anything: Automating Real-World Robots using Vision-Language Models") · 2024-06 · University of Washington; NVIDIA; Allen Institute for AI — VLM-driven system that generates real-world manipulation trajectories without privileged state or hand-designed skills; its demonstrations train behavior-cloning policies that beat ones trained on human or VoxPoser/CaP-generated data (first-party). [code](https://github.com/Robot-MA/manipulate-anything) · [project](https://robot-ma.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**SO-100 / SO-101 arms**](https://github.com/TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100) · 2024-05 · The Robot Studio / Hugging Face — Open-hardware low-cost leader-follower arm pair designed for LeRobot teleoperation and data collection; SO-101 is the revised version with easier assembly and updated leader motors. _Note: Date is repository creation (2024-05); public-release timing not confirmed._
- 🟢 [**LeRobot**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22818 "LeRobot: An Open-Source Library for End-to-End Robot Learning") · 2024-05 · Hugging Face — PyTorch library covering hardware-agnostic robot and teleop control (SO-100 arms to humanoids), the LeRobotDataset format with Hub streaming, reference policies and an asynchronous inference stack. _Note: Library launched May 2024; arXiv paper Feb 2026 (ICLR 2026)._ [code](https://github.com/huggingface/lerobot) · [docs](https://huggingface.co/docs/lerobot/index)
- 🟢 [**DROID**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.12945 "DROID: A Large-Scale In-The-Wild Robot Manipulation Dataset") · 2024-03 · Stanford / UC Berkeley / TRI et al. — 76k teleoperated demonstration trajectories (~350 h) collected across 564 scenes and 84 tasks by 50 collectors in North America, Asia and Europe; released with policy code and a hardware build guide. [code](https://github.com/droid-dataset/droid) · [project](https://droid-dataset.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**DexCap**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.07788 "DexCap: Scalable and Portable Mocap Data Collection System for Dexterous Manipulation") · 2024-03 · Stanford — Portable hand mocap (SLAM plus electromagnetic finger tracking with 3D scene capture) paired with DexIL, which learns point-cloud dexterous policies from human mocap, with optional human-in-the-loop correction in rollouts. [code](https://github.com/j96w/DexCap) · [project](https://dex-cap.github.io/) · [data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/chenwangj/DexCap-Data)
- 🟢 [**UMI**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10329 "Universal Manipulation Interface: In-The-Wild Robot Teaching Without In-The-Wild Robots") · 2024-02 · Stanford / Columbia / TRI — Hand-held gripper kit for portable in-the-wild demonstration capture plus a policy interface (latency matching, relative-trajectory actions) that yields hardware-agnostic robot policies. [code](https://github.com/real-stanford/universal_manipulation_interface) · [project](https://umi-gripper.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**ALOHA 2**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.02292 "ALOHA 2: An Enhanced Low-Cost Hardware for Bimanual Teleoperation") · 2024-02 · Google DeepMind — Redesign of ALOHA with better performance, ergonomics and robustness; all hardware designs, a build tutorial and a system-identified MuJoCo model are open-sourced. _Note: arXiv v1 is dated Feb 2024 although the ID is 2405._ [project](https://aloha-2.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**SERL**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.16013 "SERL: A Software Suite for Sample-Efficient Robotic Reinforcement Learning") · 2024-01 · UC Berkeley / University of Washington / Stanford / Intrinsic — Library bundling a sample-efficient off-policy RL method, reward and reset tooling and a Franka controller; learned PCB insertion, cable routing and relocation in 25-50 min per policy (first-party). Basis of HIL-SERL. [code](https://github.com/rail-berkeley/serl) · [project](https://serl-robot.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**Mobile ALOHA**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02117 "Mobile ALOHA: Learning Bimanual Mobile Manipulation with Low-Cost Whole-Body Teleoperation") · 2024-01 · Stanford — Adds a mobile base and whole-body teleoperation to ALOHA for collecting bimanual mobile-manipulation data; co-training with static ALOHA data improved success on tasks such as cooking and calling an elevator. [code](https://github.com/MarkFzp/mobile-aloha) · [project](https://mobile-aloha.github.io/)

**2023**

- 🟢 [**Ego-Exo4D**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.18259 "Ego-Exo4D: Understanding Skilled Human Activity from First- and Third-Person Perspectives") · 2023-11 — 1,286 h of simultaneously captured egocentric and exocentric video of skilled activities by 740 participants in 13 cities, with audio, gaze, 3D point clouds, camera poses, IMU and expert commentary, plus benchmark tasks. [project](https://ego-exo4d-data.org/)
- 🟢 [**Dobb-E**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.16098 "On Bringing Robots Home") · 2023-11 — Home-robot system built around 'The Stick', an iPhone-based demo collector used to gather 13 h of data in 22 NYC homes for pretrained representations; learned new tasks on Hello Robot Stretch from ~5 min of demos. [code](https://github.com/notmahi/dobb-e) · [project](https://dobb-e.com/) · [docs](https://docs.dobb-e.com)
- 🟢 [**Open X-Embodiment**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.08864 "Open X-Embodiment: Robotic Learning Datasets and RT-X Models") · 2023-10 · Open X-Embodiment Collaboration (21 institutions, Google DeepMind et al.) — Standardized pooling of real-robot datasets from 22 robot embodiments and 21 institutions (527 skills, 160k+ tasks), released with RT-X models that show positive transfer across robots. [code](https://github.com/google-deepmind/open_x_embodiment) · [project](https://robotics-transformer-x.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**MimicGen**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.17596 "MimicGen: A Data Generation System for Scalable Robot Learning using Human Demonstrations") · 2023-10 · NVIDIA / UT Austin — Synthesizes large demonstration sets by splitting a few human demos into object-centric subtasks and adapting them to new scenes; generated 50K+ demos over 18 tasks from ~200 human demos. [code](https://github.com/NVlabs/mimicgen) · [project](https://mimicgen.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**GELLO**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.13037 "GELLO: A General, Low-Cost, and Intuitive Teleoperation Framework for Robot Manipulators") · 2023-09 · UC Berkeley — Recipe for 3D-printed, kinematically matched leader arms built from off-the-shelf motors (Franka, UR5, xArm); a user study found it more reliable than VR controllers or SpaceMouse for demo collection. [code](https://github.com/wuphilipp/gello_software) · [project](https://wuphilipp.github.io/gello_site/)
- 🟢 [**BridgeData V2**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.12952 "BridgeData V2: A Dataset for Robot Learning at Scale") · 2023-08 · UC Berkeley et al. — 60,096 trajectories across 24 environments on a publicly available low-cost arm, conditioned on goal images or language; benchmarks six imitation and offline-RL methods and their scaling with data. [code](https://github.com/rail-berkeley/bridge_data_v2) · [project](https://rail-berkeley.github.io/bridgedata/)
- 🟢 [**RH20T**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.00595 "RH20T: A Comprehensive Robotic Dataset for Learning Diverse Skills in One-Shot") · 2023-07 · Shanghai Jiao Tong University — 110k+ contact-rich real-world manipulation sequences across skills, robots and camera views, each with visual, force, audio and action streams plus a paired human demonstration video and language. [code](https://github.com/rh20t/rh20t_api) · [project](https://rh20t.github.io/)
- 🟡 [**AnyTeleop**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.04577 "AnyTeleop: A General Vision-Based Dexterous Robot Arm-Hand Teleoperation System") · 2023-07 · UC San Diego / NVIDIA — Camera-based teleoperation stack supporting many arm, hand, simulator and camera configurations in one system; its hand-retargeting component is released as the dex-retargeting library. _Note: Project page links component code (retargeting, web visualizer) rather than the full system._ [code](https://github.com/dexsuite/dex-retargeting) · [project](https://yzqin.github.io/anyteleop/)
- 🟢 [**ALOHA**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.13705 "Learning Fine-Grained Bimanual Manipulation with Low-Cost Hardware") · 2023-04 · Stanford / Meta / UC Berkeley — Low-cost open-source bimanual leader-follower teleoperation rig plus the ACT (Action Chunking with Transformers) algorithm; learned tasks like slotting a battery from ~10 min of demos (first-party). [code](https://github.com/tonyzhaozh/aloha) · [project](https://tonyzhaozh.github.io/aloha/)

**2021**

- 🟢 [**RLDS**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.02767 "RLDS: an Ecosystem to Generate, Share and Use Datasets in Reinforcement Learning") · 2021-11 · Google Research — Lossless standard format and tools for recording, replaying, transforming and sharing sequential decision-making datasets (RL, imitation, offline RL), integrated with TFDS; used by Open X-Embodiment. [code](https://github.com/google-research/rlds)
- 🟢 [**Ego4D**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.07058 "Ego4D: Around the World in 3,000 Hours of Egocentric Video") · 2021-10 · Meta AI + university consortium — 3,670 hours of daily-life egocentric video from 931 camera wearers in 74 locations with benchmarks on episodic memory, hand-object interaction and forecasting; a common pretraining source for robot visual encoders. _Note: Download requires signing the Ego4D license agreement._ [code](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Ego4d) · [project](https://ego4d-data.org/)
- 🟢 [**robomimic**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2108.03298 "What Matters in Learning from Offline Human Demonstrations for Robot Manipulation") · 2021-08 · Stanford / UT Austin — Modular framework and demo datasets for robot learning from demonstrations, introduced with a study of six offline IL/RL algorithms on sim and real tasks; later versions add Diffusion Policy and language conditioning. [code](https://github.com/ARISE-Initiative/robomimic) · [project](https://robomimic.github.io/)

**2019**

- 🟢 [**RoboNet**](https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.11215 "RoboNet: Large-Scale Multi-Robot Learning") · 2019-10 — Open database for sharing robot experience with an initial 15M video frames from 7 robot platforms, used to study generalizable vision-based manipulation models across robots. [project](https://www.robonet.wiki/)

**2018**

- 🟡 [**RoboTurk**](https://arxiv.org/abs/1811.02790 "RoboTurk: A Crowdsourcing Platform for Robotic Skill Learning through Imitation") · 2018-11 · Stanford — Early crowdsourcing platform for 6-DoF robot teleoperation from smartphones, showing remote users can collect demonstrations efficiently even over poor network links; its sim and real datasets were released. [project](https://roboturk.stanford.edu/)
